blocks.h: GNI per person (US$, approximate, World Bank 2022, rounded)

questions.q: How many times bigger is Japan's GNI per person than India's?
Which two countries have the highest GNI per person? Suggest a reason for each.
questions.a: Qatar (oil and gas exports) and Singapore (trade, finance and its port)

questions.q: Why might GNI per person hide inequality?
questions.a: It is an average: rich and poor people within a country are hidden.

blocks.note: Figures are rounded World Bank GNI per capita (Atlas method) values for 2022; check the World Bank's current data before reusing them.

Core: In the portal response box: 'Describe how development varies across Asia.' Use the GNI table to give three examples with figures, then explain one reason.
questions.a: Uses data from at least three countries; explains a reason such as industry, oil or conflict

questions.q: Extend: Why might GNI per person hide inequality?
questions.a: It is an average; rich and poor within a country are hidden
